cap: The receptor is the same in both panels; only the timing differs. Brief pulses of GnRH let pituitary receptors recover, so gonadotrophs keep releasing LH and FSH. A continuous agonist such as leuprolide first releases stored LH (the flare), then downregulates and desensitizes the receptors, so LH, FSH and sex steroids fall to castrate levels within a few weeks.
